install.title: Install Habit tracker
install.intro: To use it as an app (and, later on, to get notifications) add it to your Home Screen and always open it from its icon.
install.step1: In Safari, tap the Share button
install.step3: Open the app from the new icon
install.safariOnly: On iPhone this has to be done in Safari.

agenda.lockedAction: Do you want to edit this day?
agenda.unlockConfirmBody: It's more than 14 days ago. Changes will recalculate your streaks and stats.
agenda.noHabitsToday: No habits due on this day.
agenda.noHabitsYet: You haven't created any habits yet.

habits.empty: You don't have any habits yet.
habits.emptyHint: Create your first one with the + button.
habits.reorderHint: Drag ≡ to reorder. The Tracker uses the same order.
habits.archiveConfirmBody: It will disappear from Agenda and Tracker, but its history is kept. You can restore it any time.
habits.deleteConfirmBody: The habit and all its history will be deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.typeLocked: The type can't be changed after the habit is created.
fields.plannedDays: Which days you plan to do it
fields.plannedDaysHint: If you do it on another day of the week, that day replaces one of the planned ones.
fields.startDateHint: The habit shows up in the Agenda from this day on.
fields.vizHint: You can change it any time without losing data.
fields.vizSoon: This visualization is coming soon. Meanwhile the default one is shown.

types.booleanHint: You either do it or you don't. E.g. “Meditate”.
types.quantitativeHint: With a goal and a unit. E.g. “8 glasses of water”.
types.negativeHint: Something to avoid. Every day counts as clean unless you log a relapse.

errors.stepRequired: The step must be greater than 0.

settings.faceIdLockHint: Ask for Face ID when opening the app or coming back to it after more than a minute.
settings.faceIdUnavailable: This device can't use Face ID from the web.
settings.exportHint: Make a copy now and then: Supabase's free plan has no automatic backups.

tracker.sortHint: Completion % is over the last 30 days. Your manual order is kept even if you use an automatic one.
tracker.dragHint: Press and hold a card, then drag it to reorder.
tracker.autoHint: To move cards by hand, switch back to manual order.
tracker.viewAsHint: ★ is the chosen visualization. Viewing it another way here doesn’t change it; edit the habit for that.

stats.title: Stats
stats.hint: Calculated over the days the habit was due. Today counts once you complete it (for negative habits, once the day is over).

heatmap.read: Each square is a day and each column a week (Monday on top). The stronger the color, the more you did; for quantitative habits, according to the amount. Very light squares are days it wasn’t due, and the outline marks today. For negative habits clean days are colored and relapses show in red.
heatmap.purpose: See your consistency over the last weeks at a glance, spot gaps and keep the chain going.
heatmap.ideal: Daily or almost daily habits: meditate, drink water, no smoking.

calendar.read: A whole month. Filled circle: done. Outlined circle: partial (quantitative) or pending today. Grey: missed. Faint number: not due that day. In the detail view you can move between months.
calendar.purpose: Review specific months and find which weekdays are hardest for you.
calendar.ideal: Habits on specific days or X times a week: gym, classes, cleaning the house.

ring.read: The ring fills with the % of due days completed this week (Monday to today) or this month, as you choose. Below it you see how many you’ve done out of those due. Today counts as soon as you complete it.
ring.purpose: A short, clear goal: close the ring this week.
ring.ideal: Any habit, especially non-daily ones: reading on weekdays, calling family.

bars.read: Each bar is the amount logged that day and the dashed line is your goal. Strong color: you reached the goal; lighter: you fell short. With 30 days it’s drawn as a line.
bars.purpose: See how much you do, not just whether you do it, and whether you’re trending up or down.
bars.ideal: Quantitative habits: glasses of water, steps, minutes of study.

days_since.read: The big number is the consecutive clean days you’ve already completed: today counts once it’s over. Below it, your record.
days_since.purpose: Watching the number grow is a reason not to start from zero again.
days_since.ideal: Negative habits: no smoking, no soda, no nail biting.
